description: Two crossfaders, each panned into one stereo output, with a stereo aux input mixed in

params.text: Crossfades that section between its A and B inputs
Places that section across the stereo output, hard left anticlockwise and hard right clockwise
Sets how much of the aux inputs is added to the outputs

inputs.text: One of the two signals that section crossfades, heard on its own with the X-FADE knob fully anticlockwise
One of the two signals that section crossfades, heard on its own with the X-FADE knob fully clockwise
Moves that section's crossfade, added to the knob, 5V taking it all the way to B
Moves that section across the stereo output, added to the knob, hard left at -5V and hard right at 5V
The left aux signal, added to the left output at the aux level
The right aux signal, added to the right output at the aux level
Adds to the aux level, 5V raising it by its whole range

outputs.text: The left side of the mix: both sections as their pan knobs place them, with the left aux added
The right side of the mix: both sections as their pan knobs place them, with the right aux added
